verdict.rationale: Superset documents its own bulk-oriented capabilities: the SDK lists "bulk task management" for scripting task creation, triage, or cleanup across one or many projects, and the orchestrate skill fans a refactor or migration out across several worktrees at once. Bulk work still runs through scripting or agent orchestration rather than a native multi-select or batch action, and there is no hands-on evidence of bulk operations. Missing for 10: a native bulk-select or batch-action UI or API endpoint, documented bulk operations on workspaces and automations beyond tasks, independent corroboration of bulk operations in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk task management: script the creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks across one or many projects.
Fan out a refactor or migration across several worktrees at once
The `superset:orchestrate` skill lets one agent coordinate workers in separate workspaces through the Superset CLI.
